product_status_mapping_policy: REVIEW_REQUIRED — draft_*_verdict values are provisional T-004A evaluation labels and MUST NOT be conflated with finalized product status enums.

scenarios.title: Zero facts from standup boilerplate + ungrounded candidate claim
review_required_items: Confirm 0-fact threshold for pure scheduling/boilerplate notes
scenarios.rationale: Meeting logistics chatter yields 0 canonical facts; required atom-01-1 has 0 supports and cannot be SOURCE_VERIFIED.

scenarios.title: Single fact clean individual delivery baseline
review_required_items: T-004B human confirmation of baseline SOURCE_VERIFIED candidate criteria
scenarios.rationale: Single unambiguous PR authored by verified owner directly supports the single required claim atom.

scenarios.title: Multiple (N=3) facts from Korean postmortem with multi-byte UTF-8 offsets
review_required_items: Confirm multi-atom aggregation rule when all N required atoms have DIRECT support
scenarios.rationale: Three Korean bullet items yield 3 canonical facts and 3 DIRECT-supported required atoms in one composite claim.

scenarios.title: DIRECT+CONTEXT grounding vs CONTEXT-only insufficient grounding
review_required_items: Confirm product state mapping for CONTEXT-only claim-04-2 (must never be SOURCE_VERIFIED)
scenarios.rationale: Background initiative goal provides CONTEXT only; claim-04-2 lacks DIRECT evidence and cannot be SOURCE_VERIFIED.

scenarios.title: CONTRADICTS across initial incident draft and corrected postmortem addendum
review_required_items: Confirm conflict precedence policy when a newer addendum contradicts an older draft
scenarios.rationale: CONTRADICTS support from addendum blocks SOURCE_VERIFIED on zero-drop claim-05-1 while supporting corrected claim-05-2.

scenarios.title: Completed delivery vs planned Q4 RFC work (Korean)
review_required_items: Confirm product state mapping (conflicting vs ungrounded) for planned-as-completed claim-06-2
scenarios.rationale: Future Q4 plan cannot verify a completed-delivery claim, while the completed health-check item is directly supported.

scenarios.title: Negation context (not deployed, reverted, cost savings not achieved)
review_required_items: Verify negation reversal rubric for claim-07-2
scenarios.rationale: Explicit negation refutes positive deployment/savings claim-07-2 while supporting rollback claim-07-1.

scenarios.title: Team achievement vs individual contribution attribution
review_required_items: Confirm attribution rubric when team-level achievement is cited only as CONTEXT
scenarios.rationale: Individual cache layer work is DIRECT-supported; solo-rebuilt overclaim-08-2 has only team CONTEXT and cannot be SOURCE_VERIFIED.

scenarios.title: Staging/test benchmark vs unstarted production deployment (Korean)
review_required_items: Confirm environment-scope conflict product state mapping for claim-09-2
scenarios.rationale: Staging benchmark results cannot verify production impact when production rollout has not started.

scenarios.title: Unverified causation and fabricated metric in a 3-atom partial claim
review_required_items: Confirm causal attribution bar when confounders exist and no A/B test was run
scenarios.rationale: Only 1 of 3 required atoms is DIRECT-supported; atom-10-2 is CONTEXT-only and atom-10-3 has 0 supports -> cannot be SOURCE_VERIFIED.

scenarios.title: Identity ambiguity (unmapped homonym 'Alex') vs verified account author
review_required_items: Confirm identity resolution threshold before allowing SOURCE_VERIFIED
scenarios.rationale: Unmapped 'Alex' shared by two team members blocks automatic SOURCE_VERIFIED on claim-11-1.

scenarios.title: User edit creates new version requiring re-verification against evidence (substantive fail & minor pending)
review_required_items: REVIEW_REQUIRED: Confirm product state transition when minor paraphrase v2 (claim-12-2) completes re-verification against fact-12-1
scenarios.rationale: User edits increment claim_version to v2 and require re-verification against evidence; v2 inflation fails (CONTRADICTS) and v2 paraphrase cannot inherit v1 SOURCE_VERIFIED prior to re-verification.

scenarios.title: User source deletion cascading to full invalidation and partial-atom invalidation
review_required_items: Confirm deleted source cascade product state naming (contrast with REF-03 unavailable)
scenarios.rationale: Explicit user deletion of src13a removes support for fact-13-1, invalidating claim-13-1 and leaving required atom-13-2 unsupported in claim-13-2.

scenarios.title: Hard negatives bundle: 10x numeric distortion and cross-project conflation
review_required_items: Confirm multi-atom precedence when CONTRADICTED and CONTEXT-only atoms coexist
scenarios.rationale: Despite 1 DIRECT anchor atom, 400ms->40ms distortion and Alpha/Borealis conflation block SOURCE_VERIFIED.
